questions.q: What real limitation does running a script from a laptop or a VM's Scheduled Task share?
options: The script only runs if the laptop is open or the VM is powered on at the right time
Both require a paid Azure Automation subscription to function at all
Neither one can ever run a PowerShell script, only Python
Scheduled Tasks and laptops cannot run scripts longer than one line
questions.explain: A closed laptop runs nothing, and a Scheduled Task's VM has to stay powered on 24/7 just in case the script needs to run — the exact problem Azure Automation solves.

questions.q: What is a runbook in Azure Automation?
options: A script, such as PowerShell or Python, imported into an Automation account to run there
A type of Azure virtual network
A billing report generated monthly by Azure
A printed manual describing how to operate a VM
questions.explain: Runbooks are imported into an Automation account with Import-AzAutomationRunbook and published before they can run on a schedule.

questions.q: What does Connect-AzAccount -Identity let a runbook do?
options: Connect only to subscriptions outside the current tenant
Sign in using the Automation account's own managed identity, with no stored app ID or client secret
Skip authentication entirely and run with no identity at all
Run exclusively as the person who created the Automation account
questions.explain: A system-assigned managed identity is an Azure-managed identity the runbook authenticates as, removing the need to store any secret in the script.

options: Deletes a schedule from an Automation account
Publishes a runbook's draft as its live version
Attaches a previously created schedule to a specific runbook so it runs at that time
Converts a PowerShell runbook into a Python runbook
questions.explain: New-AzAutomationSchedule creates the schedule object; Register-AzAutomationScheduledRunbook is the separate step linking it to the runbook that should run on it.

questions.q: Why does this lesson say a VM-based Scheduled Task is at odds with Chapter 6's cost-savings automation?
options: It requires the VM to stay powered on 24/7, which fights directly against shutting VMs down overnight to save cost
Azure Automation and Scheduled Tasks cannot coexist in the same subscription
Chapter 6 never discusses VM power state at all
Scheduled Tasks are only available on Linux, not Windows
questions.explain: Keeping a VM running around the clock just so a Scheduled Task can fire undermines the overnight VM shutdown pattern this course's later chapter automates.
